note: Candidate TOP rules P32 to P37, continuing the candidate numbering after P31 (PR-0003). Not approved, not in guidance/principles.json: the owner decides numbering. Evidence FB-0058. Full text: docs/TOP.md.

principles.title: Show Only What Is Needed Now
principles.summary: The TOP umbrella rule: show only the information the user needs at the moment they need it. Refines P05 and P10 with concrete placement rules.
rules: Default to the action, never the explanation: the label is 'Sync with Remote', with no paragraph under it.
Decide where content lives: permanently visible, hover or focus only, behind an action, or in a confirmation dialog.
Remove before adding: rename the control before adding explanatory text.
exceptions: A first run or empty state where the user genuinely cannot proceed without an instruction.

principles.title: Deliberate Tooltips
principles.summary: Tooltips are a quiet aid for one control, never a place to store essential information.
rules: Open only on deliberate hover (small delay) or keyboard focus; close on Escape, blur and leave; never persistent; never the only route to information on touch.
One short sentence. Never repeat the control label. Technical detail goes to a details view.
Prefer an obvious label or icon. Not every component needs a tooltip; no rows of info icons.
Never hide a destructive consequence only in a tooltip.

principles.title: Three Information Levels
principles.summary: Classify content by when it is needed.
rules: Level 1, always visible: name, essential status, primary action, a critical problem.
Level 2, on demand: secondary actions, branch information, logs, paths, environment, technical details.
Level 3, only when relevant: diagnostics, long explanations, error traces, advanced configuration, confirmations of dangerous operations.

principles.title: Short Status Text
principles.summary: Status and labels use the fewest words that stay clear.
rules: Prefer 'Synced', 'Running', 'Backend failed', '3 changed files', 'Stopped' to full sentences.
A status mark is always paired with a word; never colour alone.
Never truncate identifiers or paths misleadingly; provide inspect and copy of the full value.
Important errors stay reachable through Logs or Details.

principles.title: Consequences Belong In The Confirmation
principles.summary: Explain what will happen when the operation is initiated, in the confirmation dialog.
rules: The dialog names the exact target (path, branch, name) in monospace and lists consequences in short lines.
The confirm button is a specific verb (P19).
Do not warn in advance with permanent banners or only in a tooltip.

principles.title: Minimal Does Not Mean Inaccessible
principles.summary: A reduced interface keeps full keyboard and assistive technology support.
rules: Every control stays keyboard operable; row menus open with the Menu key or Shift+F10 as well as right click.
Hover-only information also appears on focus; focus stays visible (P17).
Icon-only controls keep accessible names; secrets keep Reveal and Copy.
